article_context: 文章认为英国 NHS 面对新的健康挑战已经显得过时；真正的改革不仅要加强基层和社会照护，还要关注生活、工作和社交环境等健康决定因素，并把更多权力与资源交给更了解地方需求的领导者。

article.title: 阅读 Text 2 · 英国医疗改革应从“修医院”转向提升全民健康
article.background: 文章认为英国 NHS 面对新的健康挑战已经显得过时；真正的改革不仅要加强基层和社会照护，还要关注生活、工作和社交环境等健康决定因素，并把更多权力与资源交给更了解地方需求的领导者。

sentences.en: When it was established, the National Health Service (NHS) was visionary: offering high-quality, timely care to meet the dominant needs of the population it served.
sentences.zh: 英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）创立时具有前瞻性：它提供高质量、及时的医疗服务，以满足所服务人群当时最主要的需求。

segments.text: When it was established, the National Health Service (NHS) was visionary: offering high-quality, timely care to meet the dominant needs of the population it served.

sentences.en: Nearly 75 years on, with the UK facing very different health challenges, it is clear that model is out of date.
sentences.zh: 近75年过去，英国面对的健康挑战已大不相同，很明显，这一模式已经过时。

segments.text: Nearly 75 years on, with the UK facing very different health challenges, it is clear that model is out of date.

sentences.en: From life expectancy to cancer and infant mortality rates, we are lagging behind many of our peers.
sentences.zh: 从预期寿命到癌症和婴儿死亡率，英国在许多指标上都落后于同类国家。

segments.text: From life expectancy to cancer and infant mortality rates, we are lagging behind many of our peers.

sentences.en: With more than 6.8 million on waitlists, healthcare is becoming increasingly inaccessible for those who cannot opt to pay for private treatment; and the cost of providing healthcare is increasingly squeezing out investment in other public services.
sentences.zh: 超过680万人处在候诊名单上，对无力选择私人医疗的人来说，医疗服务正变得越来越难以获得；与此同时，医疗支出也越来越多地挤占其他公共服务的投资。

segments.text: With more than 6.8 million on waitlists, healthcare is becoming increasingly inaccessible for those who cannot opt to pay for private treatment; and the cost of providing healthcare is increasingly squeezing out investment in other public services.

sentences.en: As demand for healthcare continues to grow, pressures on the workforce—which is already near breaking point—will only become more acute.
sentences.zh: 随着医疗需求持续增长，本已接近承受极限的医疗人员将面临更加严峻的压力。

segments.text: As demand for healthcare continues to grow, pressures on the workforce—which is already near breaking point—will only become more acute.

sentences.en: Many of the answers to the crisis in health and care are well rehearsed.
sentences.zh: 应对医疗与照护危机的许多办法，人们其实已经反复讨论过。

segments.text: Many of the answers to the crisis in health and care are well rehearsed.

sentences.en: We need to be much better at reducing and diverting demand on health services, rather than simply managing it.
sentences.zh: 我们必须更有效地减少并分流对医疗服务的需求，而不是仅仅管理已有需求。

segments.text: We need to be much better at reducing and diverting demand on health services, rather than simply managing it.

sentences.en: Much more needs to be invested in communities and primary care to reduce our reliance on hospitals.
sentences.zh: 需要向社区和基层医疗投入更多资源，以减少对医院的依赖。

segments.text: Much more needs to be invested in communities and primary care to reduce our reliance on hospitals.

sentences.en: And capacity in social care needs to be greater, to support the growing number of people living with long-term conditions.
sentences.zh: 社会照护能力也必须扩大，以支持越来越多患有长期疾病的人。

segments.text: And capacity in social care needs to be greater, to support the growing number of people living with long-term conditions.

sentences.en: Yet despite two decades of strategies and a number of major health reforms, we have failed to make meaningful progress on any of these aims.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管过去二十年推出了多项战略和重大医疗改革，这些目标没有一个取得实质性进展。

segments.text: Yet despite two decades of strategies and a number of major health reforms, we have failed to make meaningful progress on any of these aims.

sentences.en: That is why the Reform think tank is launching a new programme of work entitled “Reimagining health”, supported by ten former health ministers.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，Reform 智库在十名前卫生大臣支持下启动了一项名为“重新构想健康”的新计划。

segments.text: That is why the Reform think tank is launching a new programme of work entitled “Reimagining health”, supported by ten former health ministers.

sentences.en: Together, we are calling for a much more open and honest conversation about the future of health in the UK, and an “urgent rethink” of the hospital-centric model we retain.
sentences.zh: 我们共同呼吁，就英国健康体系的未来展开更加开放、坦诚的讨论，并“紧急重新审视”目前仍在沿用的以医院为中心的模式。

segments.text: Together, we are calling for a much more open and honest conversation about the future of health in the UK, and an “urgent rethink” of the hospital-centric model we retain.

sentences.en: This must begin with the question of how we maximise the health of the nation, rather than “fix” the NHS.
sentences.zh: 第一步必须是思考如何让国民整体健康达到最大化，而不是只想着“修好”NHS。

segments.text: This must begin with the question of how we maximise the health of the nation, rather than “fix” the NHS.

sentences.en: It is estimated, for example, that healthcare accounts for only about 20% of health outcomes.
sentences.zh: 例如，据估计，医疗服务本身只解释约20%的健康结果。

segments.text: It is estimated, for example, that healthcare accounts for only about 20% of health outcomes.

sentences.en: Much more important are the places we live, work and socialise—yet there is no clear cross-government strategy for improving these social determinants of health.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是我们生活、工作和社交的环境——然而目前并没有清晰的跨政府战略来改善这些健康的社会决定因素。

segments.text: Much more important are the places we live, work and socialise—yet there is no clear cross-government strategy for improving these social determinants of health.

sentences.en: Worse, when policies like the national obesity strategy are scrapped, taxpayers are left with the heavy price tag of treating the illnesses, like diabetes, that result.
sentences.zh: 更糟的是，当全国肥胖治理战略之类的政策被取消后，由此产生的糖尿病等疾病最终需要由纳税人承担高昂治疗费用。

segments.text: Worse, when policies like the national obesity strategy are scrapped, taxpayers are left with the heavy price tag of treating the illnesses, like diabetes, that result.

sentences.en: Reform wants to ask how power and resources should be distributed in our health system.
sentences.zh: Reform 希望追问：医疗体系中的权力和资源究竟应当如何分配。

segments.text: Reform wants to ask how power and resources should be distributed in our health system.

sentences.en: What health functions should remain at the centre, and what should be given to local leaders, often responsible for services that create health, and with a much better understanding of the needs of their populations?
sentences.zh: 哪些医疗职能应该保留在中央层面，哪些应该交给地方领导者？后者往往负责真正塑造健康的公共服务，也更了解当地居民的需求。

segments.text: What health functions should remain at the centre, and what should be given to local leaders, often responsible for services that create health, and with a much better understanding of the needs of their populations?
